header.subtitle: FAQ
header.title: <faq>F</faq>requently <faq>A</faq>sked <faq>Q</faq>uestions
header.description: Everything organizers usually ask before booking.

duration.q: What types of performances do you offer?
duration.a: We offer professional circus acts and complete stage shows ranging from 5 to 45 minutes, suitable for a wide variety of events.

custom.q: Can you customize your performance for our event?
custom.a: Absolutely. We can adapt the performance length, music, costumes, and overall style to match your event and audience.

technical.a: Our technical requirements vary depending on the act. A detailed technical rider is provided after the booking is confirmed.

equipment.q: Do your performances require special equipment?
equipment.a: Some aerial acts require rigging points or specific stage conditions. We coordinate all technical details with the venue in advance.

setup.q: How much setup time do you need?
setup.a: Depending on the performance, setup usually takes between 30 and 90 minutes, including equipment installation and a technical rehearsal.

experience.q: Do you have experience performing internationally?
experience.a: Yes. We have years of experience performing on cruise ships, in theaters, luxury hotels, and at prestigious events around the world.

cost.q: How much does a performance cost?
cost.a: Pricing depends on the type of event, location, performance duration, and technical requirements. Contact us for a customized quote.

outdoors.a: Yes, provided that the weather conditions and venue meet the necessary safety and technical requirements.
